==Description==
The '''Cowboy Plush''' is an upcoming official Paradoxum Games toy which is currently available to be pre-ordered. It was made by Juniper Creates. The plushie offers the Level 4 [[Cowboy]]. Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Umbra}} skin for the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin for the [[Cowboy]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards.

The revolvers of the '''Cowboy Plush''' are detachable. It is made out of plush fabric and polypropylene cotton, its size measures 13 inches (33.02 cm) tall, 10.6 inches (26.924 cm) wide and 11.8 inches (29.972 cm) long. A tree is planted for every order of the plush.

==Official Description==
*'''Online (Third)'''
*:Howdy partner, the fan favorite Cowboy tower is here as a plush and he is packing some heat with his removable revolvers. This plush does not include an in-game reward. 
*'''Online (Second)'''
*:Howdy partner, the fan favorite Cowboy tower is here as a plush and he is packing some heat with his removable revolvers. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward.
*'''Online (First)'''
*:Howdy partner, the fan favorite Cowboy tower is here as a plush and he's packing some heat with his removable revolvers.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Cowboy Plush''' can be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $34.99. If bought as part of the Cowboy Bundle, which also includes the [[Cowboy]] pin, it costs $43.18.

Before April 2025, the '''Cowboy Plush''' could be purchased for $29.99, while the bundle could be purchased for $35.98. During the Black Friday 2024 Sale, it could be bought for $22.49, while the bundle had a cost of $26.98. During the Black Friday 2025 Sale, it had a cost of $28.99, while the bundle could be bought for $36.78.
